question: What claim about the speaker's desire is at stake in wishing now to hear the worship of the siddhas from the gurus?
premises: The worship of the siddhas is a defined subject.
The speaker wishes to hear it now.
The intended source is the gurus.
inference: The speaker now desires to receive instruction on the worship of the siddhas from the gurus.
uncertainties: Whether such instruction has been received is not stated by this verse alone.
plain_english: Now I wish to hear from the gurus about the worship of the siddhas.
